ROW_PURPOSE: 35 rows marking every accepted migration (0001-0037) as already applied
NOTES: NOT business data -- bootstrap bookkeeping. Without these rows, the next npm run db:migrate would try to re-apply migration 0001 (CREATE TABLE schema_migrations, among others) against tables that already exist and fail immediately. Discovered by executing the DB test suite against a bootstrap-built database in this mission, not by inspection. Row count updated 34->35 when the PCA-LIVE-DB-0 closure pass added migration 0037.

ROW_PURPOSE: 3 rows: USD, SAR, YER (enabled ISO 4217 currencies, minor_unit_exponent=2 each)
NOTES: Required: billing_payment_attempts, billing_invoices, billing_subscriptions, etc. all carry a currency_code FOREIGN KEY into this table -- any billing write fails without it.

ROW_PURPOSE: 3 rows: YEMEN->YER, GULF->SAR, GLOBAL_OTHER->USD (default currency per commercial market)
NOTES: Required: billing_country_market_rules FOREIGN KEYs into this table.

ROW_PURPOSE: 7 rows: YE->YEMEN; SA,AE,QA,KW,BH,OM->GULF (country-code to commercial-market routing)
NOTES: Required production routing table -- determines which market/currency a parent in a given country is billed under.
Required: EntitlementService.getOrCreateForFamily reads this row to initialize account_entitlements for every new family (lazy-initialization default).
